name: NPC_Dialogue_System
description: NPC conversation system with cultural context, universal translator, reputation-gated dialogue, and educational content delivery through natural interaction.

questions.question: Translator shows cultural notes that teach real linguistics: 'Idiom mapping reveals metaphorical language structure mirroring ancient Earth cultures.' Each faction has distinct conversational norms (formal, direct, technical) teaching cultural anthropology.
questions.answer: Translator shows cultural notes that teach real linguistics: 'Idiom mapping reveals metaphorical language structure mirroring ancient Earth cultures.' Each faction has distinct conversational norms (formal, direct, technical) teaching cultural anthropology.

questions.question: Culturally-distinct dialogue with translator notes creates shareable content. 'This game explains WHY their species speaks in metaphors.' No standard dialogue trees — a first-principles redesign of game conversation.
questions.answer: Culturally-distinct dialogue with translator notes creates shareable content. 'This game explains WHY their species speaks in metaphors.' No standard dialogue trees — a first-principles redesign of game conversation.

questions.question: Every NPC has a personality profile (formality, verbosity, trust threshold) modifying dialogue style. NPCs reference past conversations and player actions. Universal translator preserves cultural context with notes overlay.
questions.answer: Every NPC has a personality profile (formality, verbosity, trust threshold) modifying dialogue style. NPCs reference past conversations and player actions. Universal translator preserves cultural context with notes overlay.

questions.question: UMG text widgets for display. JSON/DataTable driven: NPC profiles, faction templates, translation tables. One NPC with 3-5 states prototypes in 3-5 days.
questions.answer: UMG text widgets for display. JSON/DataTable driven: NPC profiles, faction templates, translation tables. One NPC with 3-5 states prototypes in 3-5 days.

questions.question: Dialogue system is new construction (no existing framework). C++ state machine + UMG + data tables. Extensible via data files for content, C++ for logic.
questions.answer: Dialogue system is new construction (no existing framework). C++ state machine + UMG + data tables. Extensible via data files for content, C++ for logic.

questions.question: UMG widgets, C++ state machine, MetaSounds, FText localization. All standard UE5.8. No engine hacks.
questions.answer: UMG widgets, C++ state machine, MetaSounds, FText localization. All standard UE5.8. No engine hacks.

questions.question: State machine is lightweight (integer state IDs, string lookups). UMG text rendering minimal cost. No GPU impact.
questions.answer: State machine is lightweight (integer state IDs, string lookups). UMG text rendering minimal cost. No GPU impact.

questions.question: All dialogue content text-based. Subtitles for spoken lines. Color-coded cultural notes have text labels. No audio-dependent information.
questions.answer: All dialogue content text-based. Subtitles for spoken lines. Color-coded cultural notes have text labels. No audio-dependent information.

questions.question: v1 text-only dialogue with ambient background. Voice acting requires professional recording budget — out of indie v1 scope.
questions.answer: v1 text-only dialogue with ambient background. Voice acting requires professional recording budget — out of indie v1 scope.

questions.question: v1 single-player only. Multiplayer dialogue queue management is out of scope.
questions.answer: v1 single-player only. Multiplayer dialogue queue management is out of scope.

questions.question: Dialogue data files are JSON/DataTable. Modders add NPCs, faction sets, translator notes, and conversation trees. Entirely content-driven.
questions.answer: Dialogue data files are JSON/DataTable. Modders add NPCs, faction sets, translator notes, and conversation trees. Entirely content-driven.

questions.question: All dialogue strings use UE5 FText (localization-ready). Standard UE5 localization pipeline. Works with community translations.
questions.answer: All dialogue strings use UE5 FText (localization-ready). Standard UE5 localization pipeline. Works with community translations.

questions.question: Depends on NPC_AI_Behavior (NPC must have AI state before dialogue triggers appropriate responses). Depends on UMG widget display.
questions.answer: Depends on NPC_AI_Behavior (NPC must have AI state before dialogue triggers appropriate responses). Depends on UMG widget display.

questions.question: Proves educational content can be delivered through natural conversation, not pop-up text boxes.
questions.answer: Proves educational content can be delivered through natural conversation, not pop-up text boxes.

questions.question: Derived from NPC_Basic Q11 (universal translator with cultural context) and Q3 (no dialogue trees, response-based communication).
questions.answer: Derived from NPC_Basic Q11 (universal translator with cultural context) and Q3 (no dialogue trees, response-based communication).

questions.question: No conflict. Dialogue is context-driven, not tree-driven. Player communicates through action and demonstrated understanding, implementing the 'no dialogue trees' principle.
questions.answer: No conflict. Dialogue is context-driven, not tree-driven. Player communicates through action and demonstrated understanding, implementing the 'no dialogue trees' principle.

questions.question: UMG widgets, C++ state machine design, FText localization, sound cue integration. Moderate. 1-2 weeks for UMG.
questions.answer: UMG widgets, C++ state machine design, FText localization, sound cue integration. Moderate. 1-2 weeks for UMG.

questions.question: Detailed enough. Future: NPC_Translation_Engine, NPC_Relationship_Tracker, NPC_Dialogue_Editor.
questions.answer: Detailed enough. Future: NPC_Translation_Engine, NPC_Relationship_Tracker, NPC_Dialogue_Editor.

questions.question: No siblings missing. AI_Behavior (foundation), Dialogue (communication), Trade (economy) cover all NPC interaction modes.
questions.answer: No siblings missing. AI_Behavior (foundation), Dialogue (communication), Trade (economy) cover all NPC interaction modes.

questions.question: NPC_Basic confirmed cultural dialogue, translation, and relationship tracking at DESIGNED status. Complete enough.
questions.answer: NPC_Basic confirmed cultural dialogue, translation, and relationship tracking at DESIGNED status. Complete enough.

questions.question: Build after AI_Behavior, before Trade. Dialogue enables trade negotiation (bargaining, cultural haggling), making it a Trade prerequisite.
questions.answer: Build after AI_Behavior, before Trade. Dialogue enables trade negotiation (bargaining, cultural haggling), making it a Trade prerequisite.

questions.question: Blocks NPC_Trade_Mechanics, faction quest system, and educational quiz delivery through NPCs.
questions.answer: Blocks NPC_Trade_Mechanics, faction quest system, and educational quiz delivery through NPCs.

questions.question: Dialogue is the primary vehicle for educational content. Through conversation, players learn linguistics, cultural anthropology, and social dynamics.
questions.answer: Dialogue is the primary vehicle for educational content. Through conversation, players learn linguistics, cultural anthropology, and social dynamics.

questions.question: Text-based without voice acting feels less polished than AAA. Acceptable: educational depth compensates for production value.
questions.answer: Text-based without voice acting feels less polished than AAA. Acceptable: educational depth compensates for production value.

questions.question: Valve commentary system, KSP tutorial integration, interactive fiction prove dialogue-driven education works.
questions.answer: Valve commentary system, KSP tutorial integration, interactive fiction prove dialogue-driven education works.

questions.question: Player learns real linguistic concepts (idiom structure, formality gradients, translation loss), cultural anthropology (norms, honorifics), and communication theory.
questions.answer: Player learns real linguistic concepts (idiom structure, formality gradients, translation loss), cultural anthropology (norms, honorifics), and communication theory.

questions.question: Can this feature be verified by sleepwalker beat tests?
questions.answer: Yes. Sleepwalker can walk through this feature and verify state changes.

questions.question: Does this feature have automated regression tests?
questions.answer: Not yet. Needs MCP screenshot baseline + SSIM comparison for visual regression.

questions.question: What are the edge cases and failure modes?
questions.answer: Edge cases include: network interruption, empty state, concurrent access, corrupted data. Documented in threat model.

questions.question: Can this feature be tested in isolation (unit test)?
questions.answer: Partially. Python modules have unit tests. UE5 Blueprint/C++ needs automated test framework.

questions.question: Is there a visual/performance baseline for regression detection?
questions.answer: Not yet. Needs MCP screenshot baseline + SSIM comparison for visual regression.
